en: iShares MSCI ACWI UCITS ETF USD (Acc)

legal_form: UCITS ETF, share class USD Accumulating of iShares V plc, Ireland; 'Product Structure: Physical', 'Methodology: Optimised'; launch 21-Oct-2011; benchmark 'MSCI All Country World Index (Net)'. Its Tel Aviv line: number 1159235, ticker iSFF505, in shekels (BlackRock's Israel brochure (library 5fae6c1d0933c1bc, p. 1, 2026-10-01)). The same share class bought abroad is record ie00b6r52259.

source.title: iShares MSCI ACWI UCITS ETF USD (Acc), factsheet, data at 05-Oct-2026, p. 1: 'Total Expense Ratio : 0.20%' (library 563983ad940955d1)

fixed_management.notes: Total expense ratio of the share class as the factsheet prints it (marketing material for UK investors; performance and net assets at 30-Sep-2026, all other data at 05-Oct-2026). The prospectus and key information document were not opened. Listed on TASE: the factsheet's p. 3 says 'also listed on: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange'; the number and the NIS line come from BlackRock's Israel brochure (library 5fae6c1d0933c1bc, p. 1, 2026-10-01), which prints the same fee.

source.title: iShares MSCI All Country World UCITS ETF U.S. Dollar (Accumulating), SSAC, factsheet 'October 2026', iShares V plc, p. 2 'Calendar year performance'

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The factsheet 'October 2026' (marketing material; performance as at 31-Oct-2026) prints the fund's return and its benchmark's for each calendar year 2016 to 2025 on p. 2; they are in tracking_record. Fund basis: 'Performance is shown on a Net Asset Value (NAV) basis, with gross income reinvested where applicable', in US dollars. Benchmark as the document names it: 'MSCI All Country World Index (Net)'. This Tel Aviv line trades units of the same share class, ISIN IE00B6R52259, as its Israeli prospectus annex names it (library b709e1e837f2aa78); the figures are that share class's NAV returns in US dollars, the same as record ie00b6r52259, not a return in shekels. The difference is not computed here (data-update rule).

share_price.notes: F-109: the Tel Aviv line is the issuer's share IE00B6R52259: its Israeli prospectus annex (https://mayafiles.tase.co.il/rpdf/1244001-1245000/P1244039-01.pdf, p. 1 'ISIN: IE00B6R52259'; p. 9 s.3 lists the exchanges where 'היחידות המוצעות' trade and s.4 'יחידות הקרן רשומות למסחר בבורסה לניירות ערך בתל אביב, והסימול שלהן הוא: אש.סז505'). So the unit's price is the issuer's dollar NAV, taken to shekels at the run's rate of the dollar; no TASE or Maya price is used.
